purpose: Backend submit and batch reset/fill source ABI and packet-reader migration
interpretation: The sole decoded direct callers supply six pointer-width arguments. Both submit functions save the third register argument (Frame) at backend-stack+0x168 and read the fifth/sixth pointer arguments at incoming stack +0x28/+0x30.
Current backend reserves 0xe238 local bytes rather than old 0x1a238; the 0xc000 reduction matches the native View array reduction.
Old reset consumes this, Frame and a byte stereo flag. Current reset consumes only this and Frame; the old third flag branch is absent. Distinct typed callback signatures are required.
Current submit passes reset object at backend-stack+0x10a0 and stores the view index at +0x1e8; old fields were +0x1090/+0x1a8.

Actual current non-indexed packet allocation uses batch+0x90 count/+0x98 array, stride0x70 and CBV/CBF at +0x50/+0x58. Indexed uses +0x94/+0xa0, stride0x88 and +0x60/+0x68. Values are stored before fill calls.
The first fill call uses temporary stack output; the packet reader must keep rejecting outputs not equal to the actual last allocated array slot.
These passive joins establish source metadata/ABI contracts, not exclusive native feature phase, object lifetime ownership or custom geometry insertion.
